responsibility: Declares the helper visitor that resolves individual fields of Rust struct literal expressions. It is a narrow companion to the main expression resolver, focused on resolving field initializer values and shorthand field names under the current lexical and canonical path prefixes rather than resolving the surrounding struct expression as a whole.
same_name_distinction: Declares the narrow ResolveStructExprField helper visitor and its entry point for resolving individual struct-expression fields under an existing prefix context. Unlike the matching .cc file, it provides the interface for this helper, not the per-field resolution implementation.
